questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'Kalakritiyon ka Bharat', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Traditional Indian art forms rely on locally available, eco-friendly materials. Aipan uses natural red clay (geru) and rice flour. Coconut shell craft transforms discarded food waste into polished, 100% biodegradable utensils. Kondapalli toys utilize soft Ponuku wood, organic tamarind seed paste, and vegetable dyes. Dhokra craft recycles brass scrap metal. None of these crafts generate plastic pollution, illustrating environmental harmony.
